ms.title: Hina YB Syerleena di TikTok: akaun dipadam pun mesti disiasat
ms.excerpt: Akaun “nowadd” menghina Ahli Parlimen Bukit Bendera dengan kata-kata kesat dan provokasi perkauman. DAPSY Bukit Bendera mengecam keras dan menggesa siasatan — siapa dia, apa motifnya, dan siapa di belakangnya.

en.title: YB Syerleena insulted on TikTok: a deleted account still needs investigating
en.excerpt: The account “nowadd” insulted the Bukit Bendera MP with vulgar, racially provocative remarks. DAPSY Bukit Bendera strongly condemned it and urged an investigation — who is behind it, and why.

zh.title: TikTok 侮辱瑟丽娜：账号删了也要追查到底
zh.excerpt: 账号“nowadd”以粗俗及带种族挑衅的言论侮辱升旗山国会议员瑟丽娜。社青团严厉斥责，促请当局调查此人的身份、动机，以及背后是否有人操控。
